originality.rationale: Full primary 2023 signed-order paper presents halfspace representations, triangulations, Ehrhart series and Gorenstein phenomena, but not the uniform-volume covariance condition number for this composite signed-clique/upper-antichain family. The bottom signed clique is already the affine image of the complete-graph fractional-stable-set polytope (2016), and is not claimed as a novel polytope. Closest mathematical statements concern signed order inradii, different signed-chain volumes, and John ellipsoids of different classical order polytopes; their results do not imply these volume moments or sharp asymptotic conditioning.
